name: Swadha Nature Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Swadha Nature Ltd operates in the agricultural produce, chemical, and natural extracts business.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SNL is engaged in:
a) Extraction & Processing: Extracting and processing juices, alkaloids (nicotine, caffeine, morphine, codeine, etc.), and compounds from plants, seeds, and agricultural produce.
b) Agrochemical Manufacturing: Manufacturing, trading, and distributing agrochemicals, including malt, maltose, malt sugar, and derivatives.
c) Trading & Distribution: Procuring, assembling, importing, exporting, and distributing agriculture-based products and chemicals.
